title: Seven-day issuance root-cause, smallest safe source fix
question: Can any authentic prospective 7/7 candidate pass the existing #1879 quote gate when the independent quote flag is always false? Find the minimal secure existing-source repair. Separate that mechanical admission defect from model abstention.
